name: excellent
description: Ready-made workflows for restaurant groups on Excellent: the morning brief across venues, lead follow-up and booking an inquiry, moving the pipeline, private-event space checks and room blocks, event prep sheets with seating, BEOs and event emails, thank-you cards, the marketing week, money owed and invoices, the owner's weekly report, the staff schedule, training the team, Partner pro formas, pitch decks and investor updates, importing a list, reviewing drafts and undoing a change. Drafts go to Excellent for a person to decide; changes can be undone.
